definitions.ask: Should the housekeeping `artifact_link_backfill` job's axe timeout also be raised from 5m to 10m as a backstop?
definitions.why: After this plan the internal budget is enforced; a 5m timeout stays a useful alarm for the next gap.

choices.label: Timeout stays 5m, so a timeout still flags a budget-enforcement bug
Timeout becomes 10m; absorbs uninterruptible tails but hides future budget regressions
